_doc: Paralia brand component rules. Edit here, run compile.js to regenerate compiled/paralia-components.css.

button._doc: Paralia buttons are pill-shaped, matching the chip toggle and brand aesthetic.

chip._doc: Chip toggles are pill-shaped in Paralia.

slider._doc: Slider track is thin (3px), thumb uses --color-signal (orange).

input._doc: Inputs are pill-shaped in Paralia, matching buttons and chips.

badge._doc: Badges are small and sharp-cornered for data density.

card._doc: Cards and panel islands use large rounding in Paralia.
